[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Ratchet the sase-core-rs window at the release boundary instead of [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]on feature PRs[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A feature agent can call a newly landed sase-core binding or [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]literal, and without waiting on a core release; the published-floor[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]invariant is enforced once, mechanically, on the pending sase [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]release instead of ~1.2 times a day by a dedicated agent.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Derive the telemetry smoke test's expected minimum from [/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]pyproject[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]derive-floor-literal[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]derive-floor-literal: replace the hardcoded "0.21.3" golden assertion in[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tests/test_sase_core_rs_telemetry_smoke_tool.py with a value derived [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]from pyproject.toml, so a floor change stops requiring a test edit.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Build the window ratchet tool[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ratchet-tool[dim] · [dim][/dim]after derive-floor-literal[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ratchet-tool: add a stdlib-only tools/ratchet_core_window that selects [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the newest fully published stable sase-core-rs from PyPI, rewrites only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that requirement in pyproject.toml through one tested ceiling-policy [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]function, refreshes uv.lock with a bounded diff guard, and supports [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]--check/--report-only with idempotence and downgrade refusal.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Enforce the published floor on the release branch and at [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]publish time[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]release-lane[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]release-lane: add a CI job that runs only on the release-please branch [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and validates the exact declared PyPI core floor against bindings, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wire-schema probes, smokes and the contract set, and pin the floor [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exactly in publish.yml's install-smoke so an incompatible floor [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]mechanically blocks the PyPI upload.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Ratchet the window on the pending release branch in [/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]report-only mode[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]release-ratchet[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ratchet-tool[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]release-ratchet: extend publish.yml's sync-lockfile job into a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sync-release-metadata reconciler that runs the ratchet tool ahead of the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lock refresh, landing it in report-only mode so a real release can be [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]observed before it writes anything.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Verify one report-only run and switch the ratchet to apply[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]enable-ratchet[dim] · [dim][/dim]after release-lane, release-ratchet[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]enable-ratchet: read the report-only output from at least one real [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]master push with a pending release branch, confirm the proposed version [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and diff are exactly right, then flip the reconciler to apply and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]confirm the release branch stays green.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop conscripting feature agents into the floor bump[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]retire-conscription[dim] · [dim][/dim]after enable-ratchet[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]retire-conscription: remove published-core-minimum-smoke from feature [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]PRs and master pushes now that the invariant is enforced at the release [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]boundary, and rewrite the three Justfile warnings and the docs that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]currently tell agents to bump the window by hand.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Add a non-fatal core-floor probe to just check[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]early-warning[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]early-warning: add a cached, offline-tolerant tools/probe_core_floor [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that runs the two stdlib probes against the declared floor, names the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-core commit and release that provides any missing capability, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wire it into just check and just check-full as a warning that can never [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fail the run.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Merge sase-core release PRs from the release-plz workflow[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]core-automerge[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-automerge: add a guarded job to sase-core's release-plz.yml that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]waits for the release PR's checks and squash-merges it, collapsing a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]median 43-minute and worst-case 9h36m human wait into roughly ten [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]minutes.[/#D7D7AF]
